_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::xfem_fluid#1 and a FALSIFICATION of its Signal. The entry claimed the linear solver fails with 'Belos: condition number > 1e16' or 'solver diverged after 0 iterations'. Neither string is emitted by 4C or by any Trilinos library it links. On the upstream Fluid_XFEM deck xfluid_ls_neumann_inflow_stab, GHOST_PENALTY_STAB: false runs the full three steps, reaches 'Checking results of 4 tests', and fails three of them -- pressure moves by 7.2e-4 -- while the solver reports nothing at all. Ghost penalty is therefore an accuracy switch whose absence is silent, not a solver-robustness switch that announces itself. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: leave ghost-penalty stabilisation on. The second arm becomes the baseline, exits 0 and matches every result test, so the fixture must go red.
